mapper.select: SELECT refund_order_id, payment_order_id, order_no, customer_name, paid_amount, refund_amount, refund_method, refund_reason, status, channel_refund_id, applied_at, success_at FROM t_refund_order WHERE refund_order_id = #{refundOrderId}

SELECT refund_order_id, payment_order_id, order_no, customer_name, paid_amount, refund_amount, refund_method, refund_reason, status, channel_refund_id, applied_at, success_at FROM t_refund_order WHERE idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey}

SELECT log_no, refund_order_id, action_code, action_name, from_status, to_status, operator_name, operation_remark, operated_at FROM t_refund_operation_log WHERE refund_order_id = #{refundOrderId} ORDER BY operated_at ASC, id ASC
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(refund_amount), 0) FROM t_refund_order WHERE payment_order_id = #{paymentOrderId} AND status IN ('REVIEWING', 'APPROVED', 'PROCESSING', 'SUCCESS')
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO t_refund_payment_source (payment_order_id, order_no, customer_name, paid_amount, channel_code, paid_at, updated_at) KEY (payment_order_id) VALUES (#{paymentOrderId}, #{orderNo}, #{customerName}, #{paidAmount}, #{channelCode}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

INSERT INTO t_refund_order (refund_order_id, payment_order_id, order_no, customer_name, paid_amount, refund_amount, refund_method, refund_reason, status, idempotency_key) VALUES (#{refundOrderId}, #{paymentOrderId}, #{orderNo}, #{customerName}, #{paidAmount}, #{refundAmount}, #{refundMethod}, #{refundReason}, #{status}, #{idempotencyKey})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_refund_order SET status = #{targetStatus}, failure_code = #{failureCode}, approved_at = CASE WHEN #{targetStatus} = 'APPROVED' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE approved_at END, submitted_at = CASE WHEN #{targetStatus} = 'PROCESSING' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE submitted_at END, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE refund_order_id = #{refundOrderId} AND status = #{expectedStatus}

UPDATE t_refund_order SET status = #{targetStatus}, channel_refund_id = COALESCE(#{channelRefundId}, channel_refund_id), failure_code = #{failureCode}, success_at = CASE WHEN #{targetStatus} = 'SUCCESS' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE success_at END, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE refund_order_id = #{refundOrderId} AND status = 'PROCESSING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_refund_operation_log (log_no, refund_order_id, action_code, action_name, from_status, to_status, operator_name, operation_remark) VALUES (CONCAT('RLOG-', REPLACE(UUID(), '-', '')), #{refundOrderId}, #{actionCode}, #{actionName}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{operatorName}, #{remark})

INSERT INTO t_refund_outbox_event (event_id, event_type, aggregate_id, payload_json, status) VALUES (CONCAT('REVT-', REPLACE(UUID(), '-', '')), 'REFUND_SUCCESS', #{refundOrderId}, CONCAT('{"refundOrderId":"', #{refundOrderId}, '","paymentOrderId":"', #{paymentOrderId}, '","refundAmount":"', #{refundAmount}, '"}'), 'PENDING')
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) AS total_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'REVIEWING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS reviewing_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'PROCESSING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS processing_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'FAIL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fail_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN refund_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS success_amount FROM t_refund_order

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_refund_outbox_event
AND event_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{eventId}, '%')
AND aggregate_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{aggregateId}, '%')
AND status = #{status}
SELECT id, event_id, event_type, aggregate_id, payload_json, status, retry_count, last_error_message, last_relay_at, created_at, updated_at FROM t_refund_outbox_event WHERE event_id = #{eventId}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_refund_outbox_event SET status = 'SENT', last_error_message = NULL, last_relay_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'FAIL')

UPDATE t_refund_outbox_event SET status = 'FAIL', retry_count = retry_count + 1, last_error_message = #{lastErrorMessage}, last_relay_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'FAIL')
